profile.headline: Software Engineer- Media Applications at NFL Films
profile.summary:
As a senior software developer, I cover the complete software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and stakeholder collaboration to deployment. My skills include web application development, database administration, cloud computing, and leading Agile/Scrum teams. I am proficient in C#, .NET, Angular, Python, Go, Azure, AWS, and more.

Among my career highlights is modernizing legacy systems at WEX Inc., which enhanced data reliability and processing efficiency. I also led the development of a custom ASP.NET user monitoring application and successfully mentored several developers, boosting team productivity. Earlier, I created a significant Active Directory integration application at Thycotic Software. I am eager to contribute my experience in software engineering and technical leadership to an organization that prioritizes innovation and quality. Let's connect to discuss how I can help drive your technology initiatives forward.
